description: This file defines a client-side React component for handling OAuth callback logic in a web application. It reads URL search parameters, displays callback information, and optionally redirects back to an integrations page with status banners.

classes.name: StatusBadge
classes.description: A React functional component rendering a status badge with color coding based on the status type.

methods.name: OAuthCallbackClient
methods.description: Main React functional component that processes OAuth callback URL parameters, performs redirect if needed, and renders callback details.
